issues.description: The Stock.findStockIngredient method signature in the template does not match the specification and the solution: the problem statement and the solution expect findStockIngredient(String) but the template declares findStockIngredient(String, boolean). This mismatch will cause compilation errors and confusion when students implement SealSaloon (which and the example code call stock.findStockIngredient(name) with a single String parameter).
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template Stock.findStockIngredient signature to match the problem statement and solution: public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name). Alternatively, provide an overloaded single-argument method that delegates to the two-argument version (or remove the two-argument variant). Ensure add/take and example code call the single-argument method so students can implement SealSaloon without compilation errors.
